statement: The sandbox bash tool runs commands with /bin/sh, which is dash (/bin/sh -> dash): bash-only syntax such as process substitution <(...) fails with 'Syntax error: \"(\" unexpected'.
rationale: The sandbox bash tool runs /bin/sh = dash; bash-only syntax (process substitution, PIPESTATUS) fails. Plan scripts use #!/usr/bin/env bash or 'bash x.sh' and its inline commands are POSIX, but implementers writing ad-hoc commands may hit this.
amendment: ENVIRONMENT.md: note 'sandbox /bin/sh is dash: run bash-isms through bash -c'.

statement: In the sandbox, background jobs started with plain '&' die when the tool call ends and need `setsid nohup <cmd> > log 2>&1 < /dev/null &`; the shell is dash (no `time` keyword, no `disown`); the git p
rationale: Background jobs with plain & die at the end of the tool call (need setsid nohup ... < /dev/null &); /bin/sh is dash; a shallow clone must git fetch origin main before push or the push gets HTTP 413; git proxy allows two concurrent operations.
amendment: ENVIRONMENT.md sandbox section: run long builds via setsid nohup and poll; use bash -c for bash syntax; run git fetch origin before first push if the clone is shallow; avoid concurrent git operations.
